queries.result: Found Koriyama City official GIS guidance and its public SonicWeb viewer. The official viewer advertises a 地番参考図 (parcel-number reference map) based on cadastral maps and aerial photography.

queries.result: 郡山市公式GISの地番参考図を確認。公式viewer設定に地番参考図テーマと筆界 feature class 1021(th_18) があり、匿名APIからfeatureidとポリゴンを取得できた。

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Koriyama City DX Strategy Division / Koriyama City GIS
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official page links the public GIS and lists 地番参考図マップ, current at 2026-01-01; it warns the map is a reference display and not proof of boundaries or rights.
Viewer configuration identifies theme th_18 地番参考図 and feature class 1021(th_18) 筆界 with displayed fields 字名 and 地番.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Koriyama City Agricultural and Infrastructure Division
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official cadastral-survey page distinguishes cadastral maps/books from Legal Affairs Bureau registry records and documents partial survey progress; this is custodian/procedure evidence, separate from the public reference-map service.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Fetched official viewer HTML and followed its current map.js configuration. No login or credentials used.
Configuration exposed apiUrl https://www.sonicweb-asp.jp/koriyama2/api/, theme th_18, feature class 1021(th_18), and attributes 字名/地番.
Bounded anonymous response returned three native featureids (12170901-12170903), centroids, and metadata; the first response included full geometry while two required detail requests.

Fetched full polygons for native feature IDs 12170902 and 12170903. Geometry is GeoJSON-like Polygon in decimal coordinate pairs visibly ordered longitude, latitude; the response declares no CRS, so CRS remains unverified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Koriyama City public 地番参考図 reference-map layer and the city's cadastral-survey/registry custodial context.

coverageAssessment.openGeometryScope: city viewer layer, not independently established as complete cadastral coverage
coverageAssessment.registryExistenceScope: Koriyama City official GIS and cadastral-survey custodian evidenced; public layer is explicitly a reference map and not a legal boundary proof.

qualityAssessment.geometryQuality: three full Polygon samples retained; no topology or positional accuracy assessment
qualityAssessment.identityReadiness: native featureid observed; service schema/CRS qualification still required
qualityAssessment.attributesRequested: Only IDs and geometry were retained; no owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax or account fields requested or retained.

blocker: The public layer is a city reference map, and its API response does not declare CRS or an authoritative cadastral completeness guarantee; serial qualification is required before adapter admission.
remainingUncertainty: The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted. The bounded sample is near the viewer's default extent, not an exact-point hit and not evidence of citywide coverage or absence.
nextStep: Serial reviewer should independently confirm CRS, native identity stability, coverage semantics, and whether this reference layer is admissible for parcel runtime use.
identityPolicy: Retained GeoJSON uses only the official featureid as canonical id; source field names and featureid/typename provenance remain in this metadata.
notes: Official viewer explicitly labels this as 地番参考図 (reference map). No raw source attribute sets retained.
